title: Create a fraud dispute case
description: Start a fraud dispute case from the transactions a user reports as fraudulent

# Create a fraud dispute case

Create a fraud dispute case **with the API** when one of your users reports fraud.
The case starts as a draft, so you can add details and documents before you [submit it](./guide-submit.mdx).
Swan doesn't receive the case until it's submitted.

:::tip Prerequisites
- You have a [project access token](/developers/using-api/authentication/guide-get-token-project), or a [user access token](/developers/using-api/authentication/guide-get-token-user) for a user who [can report the transactions](./index.mdx#fraud-permissions).
- You have the IDs of the [reportable transactions](./index.mdx#reportable) from one incident.
:::

## Guide {#guide}

1. Call the `draftFraudDisputeCase` mutation.
1. Add the `transactionIds` (line 4). This is the only required input.
1. Add the `fraudDetails` you have (lines 5-13). They're required to submit. See [fraud details](./index.mdx#fraud-details).
1. Add `fraudCardDetails` if the case includes card payments, and `fraudTransferDetails` if it includes transfers (lines 14-15).
1. For a transfer-only case, add the `victimAccountMembershipId` (not shown). See [victim](./index.mdx#victim).
1. Optionally, add your own `externalReference` (line 16).
1. Add the success payload (line 19).
1. Add [rejections](./index.mdx#rejections) (not shown).

## Mutation {#mutation}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {4-5,14-16,22,30} showLineNumbers
mutation CreateFraudDisputeCase {
  draftFraudDisputeCase(
    input: {
      transactionIds: ["$CARD_TRANSACTION_ID", "$TRANSFER_TRANSACTION_ID"]
      fraudDetails: {
        reportedReason: Unauthorized
        reportedTypology: ImpersonationOrPhishing
        description: "I entered my card details on a fake delivery website. The next day, I saw a card payment and a transfer I didn't make."
        discoveredAt: "2026-12-01"
        fraudsterChannels: [Sms, Website]
        sharedInformationWithFraudster: [CardDetails, VerificationCode]
        hasFiledPoliceComplaint: true
      }
      fraudCardDetails: { isLostOrStolen: false, hasContactedMerchant: false }
      fraudTransferDetails: { hasContactedBankOrBeneficiary: true }
      externalReference: "$YOUR_REFERENCE"
    }
  ) {
    ... on DraftFraudDisputeCaseSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      disputeCase {
        id
        statusInfo {
          status
          ... on DisputeCaseDraftStatusInfo {
            expiresAt
          }
        }
        supportingDocumentCollection {
          id
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

## Payload {#payload}

Save the case `id` (line 6) and the supporting document collection `id` (line 12).
You need them to [upload documents](./guide-upload-documents.mdx) and submit the case.

```json title="Payload" {6,12} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "draftFraudDisputeCase": {
      "__typename": "DraftFraudDisputeCaseSuccessPayload",
      "disputeCase": {
        "id": "$DISPUTE_CASE_ID",
        "statusInfo": {
          "status": "Draft",
          "expiresAt": "2026-12-31T10:15:00.000Z"
        },
        "supportingDocumentCollection": {
          "id": "$COLLECTION_ID"
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

:::caution Retrying after a network error
Creating a case isn't idempotent, so a retry can create a second draft.
Before retrying, [check for an existing draft](./guide-get-info.mdx#account) with the same transactions.
:::
